Legends Viewer is a [[utility]] for 0.47 and earlier versions of DF that loads up the legends you can export in a much more usable format than the [[Legends mode]] of DF itself.  Legends Viewer can open pages in new tabs, filter information on a wide range of criteria, and display information on the map as well. Binaries are only available for Windows, as well as the source (written in C#).

It takes four files as input:  the legends XML file, the sites and pops text, world history text, and a map image.  It can load these separately, but it is recommended to load them as a single compressed archive (folder) - the XML can be multiple GB uncompressed for long histories, and reduce to less than 5% of its size.

[[Utilities#LegendsViewer-Next|LegendsViewer-Next]] is a successor for v50 Steam/Premium.
